sources.snippet: Overview Gemma-4-31B-JANG_4M-CRACK is a 31-billion-parameter dense transformer model built by dealignai through abliteration of Google's instruction-tuned Gemma 4. The model uses JANG v2 mixed-precision quantization (8-bit attention, 4-bit MLP) to fit in 18-21 GB while maintaining 93.7% HarmBench compliance with only a 2-5% MMLU penalty. sources.snippet: Multimodal image-text-to-text fork of Gemma 4 (31B) using a 'CRACK v2' abliteration — tuned for conversational vision inputs and thinking-mode support in JANG v2 safetensors format. Recommended to run in vMLX; published by dealignai.
